title.context: Card heading (Add screen widget, Budget and Insights): what's left of the month's income at its end.

noIncomeCurrent.message: Zapisuj wypłaty przyciskiem „+ Dochód” na karcie Dodaj, a tu pojawi się prognoza tego, co zostanie na koniec miesiąca.
noIncomeCurrent.context: Forecast card when this month has no income logged. '+ Income' is the button on the Add tab (use its translated name).

noIncomePast.message: W tym miesiącu nie zapisano dochodu.
noIncomePast.context: Forecast card for a past month without income.

expected.context: Forecast card, under Income: a person's typical pay, used until this month's paycheck is logged. '~' means about.

onCourseSave.message: Zmierza do odłożenia {amount} w tym miesiącu.
onCourseSave.context: Forecast card headline (current month). Keep the <b> tags.

onCourseSaveRate.message: Zmierza do odłożenia {amount} w tym miesiącu, {percent}% dochodu.
onCourseSaveRate.context: Forecast card headline (current month) with the share of income saved. Keep the <b> tags.

onCourseOverspend.message: Zmierza do wydania {amount} więcej, niż zarabiacie w tym miesiącu.
onCourseOverspend.context: Forecast card headline (current month) when spending is projected above income. Keep the <b> tags.

saved.context: Forecast card headline for a past month. Keep the <b> tags.

savedRate.context: Forecast card headline for a past month with the share of income saved. Keep the <b> tags.

overspent.context: Forecast card headline for a past month that spent more than it earned. Keep the <b> tags.

stillToSpend.context: Forecast card: legend of the lighter bar segment, spending projected for the rest of the month.

leftOver.context: Forecast card: legend and label, income minus spending at the month's end.

shortfall.context: Forecast card table: spending above income.

projected.context: Forecast card: the whole month's spending, projected.

soFar.context: Forecast card: under projected spending, what's been spent so far.

breakEven.context: Forecast card: label of what can be spent per day without spending more than the income.

breakEvenDetail.context: Forecast card, under 'To break even'. Keep the <b> tags.

goal.context: Forecast card: label with the main savings goal's name.

goalDetail.one: ok. {count} miesiąc, gdyby taka nadwyżka szła na niego co miesiąc
goalDetail.few: ok. {count} miesiące, gdyby taka nadwyżka szła na niego co miesiąc
goalDetail.many: ok. {count} miesięcy, gdyby taka nadwyżka szła na niego co miesiąc
goalDetail.other: ok. {count} miesiąca, gdyby taka nadwyżka szła na niego co miesiąc
goalDetail.context: Forecast card, under 'Goal: …': how long the goal takes at this month's surplus. Keep the <b> tags.

expectedNote.message: „Spodziewane” to typowy miesiąc tej osoby, liczony, dopóki nie zostanie zapisana tegomiesięczna wypłata.

balance.context: Forecast card: label next to the big signed number, income minus spending of a finished month.

balanceProjected.context: Forecast card: label next to the big signed number in the running month, income minus projected spending at the month's end.

projectionSplit.message: Rachunki i raty {fixed} liczone raz, codzienne {everyday}
projectionSplit.context: Forecast card (running month), under the projected spending: how it's made up. {fixed} is bills and debts counted once at what they usually come to, {everyday} the rest at the month's end. Both formatted money.

projectionOneOffs.context: Forecast card (running month): added after the projection's make-up when there are big one-off expenses, counted once. {amount} is formatted money.
